CREATURE/GOBLINSHREDDERMOUNT/GOBLINSHRED.note: I-364: the HD shredder mesh hangs the 3.3.5a client when a combat animation plays. Confirmed with `.morph 31484` and attacking on foot -- no vehicle involved. Against the stock 3.3.5 mesh (Asset Library) it differs in exactly two WotLK-relevant ways: globalFlags 0x90 vs 0x10 (bit 0x80 is a post-WotLK flag; m2_head_rebase.py masks these to & 0x1F) and NO bone tagged keyBoneId 6 (Head) vs stock's bone 6. HD bone 5 is unambiguously the head: its pivot is 0.060 from stock's head pivot and its parent carries keyBoneId 4, exactly like stock's head parent. Shared by 9 creatures across displays 26559/26612/31484, including stock Wintergrasp shredders, so it is repaired in place rather than swapped out.
